messages:
sarah.m: quick sync  pulling together the launch bench playbook + a compact battlecard for SDRs. goal: 2 hero claims, 3 quick rebut bullets, and explicit inbound routing. who can help with copy + routing rules? :sparkles:

mike.r: i can handle slide copy. propose hero claims: 1) p99 latency guarantees at scale, 2) measurable per-token savings via batching & caching. keep it tight.

claire: agree on the two. i'll add a tiny visual that shows cost delta for 8k vs 2k seqs. note: numbers vary by model family. we'll include a callout.

sarah.m: perfect. for rebuttals vs cloud platforms and LLM APIs i want short lines that SDRs can say in 10s. examples?

emily.k: draft rebut bullets: 
- vs managed cloud endpoints: "Nice for quick proofs, but production inference needs runtime controls (KV cache, model fallbacks) and observability to keep costs predictable."
- vs public LLM APIs: "APIs are easy, but lack deployment options and cost levers for high-volume apps."
- vs infra vendors: "Bare infra still leaves you building the operational layer; we ship the runtime + rollout primitives."

ravi: inbound routing rules: add checkboxes on the webinar form & auto-tags. suggested tags: ["Dedicated interest", "Private/VPC", "Bench request", "Proof-of-concept"]. routing table: Dedicated -> AM + Solutions Eng; Private/VPC -> Enterprise SE + Security; Bench request -> Growth SDR + Product Marketing.

claire: can we add a short snippet for SDRs to use on reply? e.g., "Thanks for joining — would you like a short bench vs your current setup? We can run a 48hr focused perf test."

emily.k: yes, and include an escalation note: if compliance is mentioned (HIPAA/SOC2), route immediately to Enterprise SE and Security.

sarah.m: timeline: mike to drop slide copy by Tue noon, claire adds perf visuals by Tue EOD, ravi to publish form + routing rules Wed morning, emily drafts 250-word post tying the bench to a customer example by Thu. everyone ok? react with :thumbsup:.

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar slot reserved for 2026-05-12 11:00 PDT. Recording will be archived in #events.

mike.r: :thumbsup:

claire: :thumbsup: added visual placeholder in drive (link in thread).

ravi: :thumbsup: routing rules drafted, will post PR in the docs repo by Wed AM.

emily.k: :thumbsup: starting the blog draft, will ping for data points.

sarah.m: thanks all  i'll collate and link the battlecard PR when ready.
